scope: Complete stable F08 production module, independent reference, entire new test file, entire coverage report, frozen protocol/golden, existing scalar callers and relevant clock/instrument/journal adapters. No market data or original archive read.
caller_search: Recursive static grep across src/tests/references: production F08 functions currently have only internal and finite test callers; verify GROUPS registers tests.test_roll_transitions with F08/F08.ROLL_PARITY. No claim of all production integration.

findings.title: Mixed-profile test expects an exception that the actual branch cannot raise
findings.trigger: The test changes source.coordinate to self.new while destination remains self.new. transition_state rejects equal lifetimes at lines597-598 with ContractError before its bridge mismatch branch.
findings.consequence: The registered suite will fail this test by static control-flow inspection; DependencyUnavailable is a subclass of ContractError, not vice versa.
findings.suggested_correction: Use assertRaises(ContractError) for this same-destination case; separately construct a third distinct coordinate if testing the missing matching bridge DependencyUnavailable path.
findings.test_coverage: No test run performed; direct branch and exception hierarchy inspection.

findings.title: Derived publication discards original validity endpoints
findings.trigger: A source CoordinateState can have clocks.valid_until=106, horizon_end=110, cut105 and completion107. source.available(cut) succeeds, then derived_clocks drops validity and output becomes available107. Analogously a mapping with clocks.valid_until201 may publish selection202, and action/observation clocks expiring101 may publish AdjustmentResult102.
findings.consequence: Expired inputs produce newly usable outputs; this violates frozen contract2 original validity endpoints do not restart.
findings.suggested_correction: Carry the applicable original validity intersections into output horizon/availability and reject completion beyond them. Preserve historical-observation semantics explicitly where needed rather than silently discarding an explicit valid_until. Add source/map/action completion-across-validity cases.
findings.test_coverage: Current publication tests only bound explicit horizon_end; all their input clocks lack restrictive validity.

findings.title: RollSelection accepts inconsistent output or pre-input publication and survives the ledger
findings.trigger: replace(self.select(), coordinate=self.old) retains volume20 winner evidence but changes selected contract to loser. Replacing timing with PublicationTiming(0,1,1,250) also passes typed-only post_init. RollLedger._validate has no RollSelection branch and require_raw_contract_parity trusts its availability.
findings.consequence: An invalid decision can be committed/restored and accepted as a published selection, including before universe/calendar/volume evidence existed. Content hashes merely freeze the invalid content.
findings.suggested_correction: Retain sufficient immutable selector inputs, including definition terms/expiry, and semantically validate/reconstruct every RollSelection on creation and append/restore. Check input clocks, policy/source-map consistency, eligibility, winner and horizon.
findings.test_coverage: No test appends/restores a RollSelection or tampers with selection result fields. Existing tests exercise only select_roll factory.

findings.title: AdjustmentResult accepts fabricated arithmetic and premature publication
findings.trigger: Take apply_action output then replace values with a different exact price or replace timing with PublicationTiming(0,1,1,200). Constructor checks shapes/types only; ledger checks only that action was registered.
findings.consequence: A wrong split/dividend result or a result predating action effect/source publication is committed and returned as usable.
findings.suggested_correction: Retain all original transformation inputs including quantity and validate/recompute values, coordinate, effect/input clocks and timing in constructor and ledger restore. Add forged-price, forged-quantity, early-effect and early-receipt cases.
findings.test_coverage: Tests never append an AdjustmentResult; action_revision test only stores source actions, despite its prior-result name.

findings.title: Derived destination identity is not reserved against conflicting base-state reuse
findings.trigger: After committing transition, destination.id exists only in _states keyed by version, not _records keyed by id. Append replace(result.destination, chain=(), coordinate=self.old), retaining the destination id. _validate permits its empty chain, _records has no ID conflict, and it becomes a registered source that can be translated again.
findings.consequence: The same destination object identity can acquire conflicting source content and the spread can be applied twice, violating frozen contract6. A preexisting top-level record with id equal to a future destination id is also not rejected.
findings.suggested_correction: Maintain one content/role identity registry including nested derived destination IDs, reject conflicts against it before commit, and validate base-state provenance so clearing chain cannot bypass known derived identity. Preserve this registry on restore.
findings.test_coverage: Current relabelling test retains a nonempty chain and therefore only tests the easy chain guard.

findings.title: Availability gates omit declared coordinate/source validity
findings.trigger: CoordinateState.available checks clocks and horizon but not coordinate.available(at). require_option_underlying likewise accepts a quote after expected.valid_until when quote clocks have no end. action_at returns an effective action after action.clocks.valid_until although record(action.id) correctly withholds it.
findings.consequence: Expired raw state/option underlier/action evidence remains consumable through these public gates, inconsistently with other F08 accessors.
findings.suggested_correction: Apply coordinate lifetime at live state/raw-option query cuts; apply action.clocks.available at action_at. Explicit historical valid_at semantics should be separate if supported. Add expired/future-validity boundary tests.
findings.test_coverage: Existing raw-option query is inside lifetime; state fixture lifetime greatly exceeds horizon; action fixtures have no validity endpoints.

findings.title: RawCoordinate.from_definition can outlive explicit contract expiry
findings.trigger: New test helper intentionally uses expiry1000/1200 but definition.clocks.valid_until2000. from_definition copies2000 and drops expiry. A selection made before expiry with a long map/session horizon and RawFill thereafter can remain valid after the contract expires.
findings.consequence: An unexpired-at-cut contract becomes a coordinate valid for fills/comparisons after its exact expiry.
findings.suggested_correction: Intersect definition validity with expiry when creating an expiring raw coordinate (or reject inconsistent definition intervals); ensure selection horizon cannot extend past expiry. Preserve definition/lifetime evidence explicitly.
findings.test_coverage: Expired-competitor test checks expiry only at selection cut; no completion or fill crossing expiry is tested.

findings.title: Cash arithmetic accepts unqualified or mixed currencies
findings.trigger: raw_fill_pnl accepts individually valid USD and EUR entry/exit legs and adds their gross/fees into one scalar with no currency. Separately from_definition unconditionally assigns USD to any execution-eligible root even though InstrumentDefinition has no currency field and this method does not restrict NQ/ES.
findings.consequence: Dimensionally incompatible cash amounts can be reported as one P&L, and a generic definition can silently acquire a currency not present in its evidence.
findings.suggested_correction: Require a single explicit currency for this finite aggregator (or return per-currency totals), include currency in output, and restrict the convenience adapter to its evidenced supported USD products or require explicit currency evidence.
findings.test_coverage: Existing P&L fixture has only NQ/USD legs; no mixed or unsupported currency case.

findings.title: Literal selector and kernel disagree on identical volume redelivery
findings.trigger: Duplicate an identical prior-session volume receipt in otherwise identical finite inputs. Kernel select_prior_volume deduplicates same-time rows by v.version at line176 and selects normally; literal.select_volume counts both same-time candidates and raises unavailable.
findings.consequence: The independent comparator does not express the kernel duplicate semantics for the same receipt inputs, so duplicate/reference parity is untested and currently inconsistent.
findings.suggested_correction: Give primitive oracle rows explicit receipt/source identity, deduplicate exact same-content repeats independently, and preserve conflicts as unavailable. Add duplicate and conflicting duplicate reference/kernel assertions.
findings.test_coverage: Only a unique two-row literal selector fixture is tested; current primitive conversion also omits source identity.

findings.title: Corporate action logical identity can fork or cross assets without rejection
findings.trigger: Append two initial CorporateAction records with the same logical_id but different assets, kinds, or unrelated source lineage and different known_at. Both supersedes=None records bypass chain validation; action_at(logical_id) silently returns the latest. Two revisions can also name the same older parent while bypassing immediate predecessor order.
findings.consequence: A lookup can switch assets/actions or accept a disconnected revision as the same logical action, weakening revision evidence despite matching parent checks for the narrow supersedes branch.
findings.suggested_correction: Bind each logical action identity to one asset/kind and one declared revision chain, reject disconnected roots/conflicting branches (or represent and expose explicit unresolved branches), and enforce the declared predecessor relation.
findings.test_coverage: Current action test checks a valid revision and a missing parent only; no duplicate root, asset collision or fork test.

coverage_assessment.last_case_F08_26: No test methods, explicit full economic/production/operational remaining gates; correctly not claimed closed.
coverage_assessment.scope_limits: Real E0 parent cohort, native bridge/action evidence, full object/order/account/payoff integrations, empirical uncertainty/warmup and P0-P7 remain unclosed.
coverage_assessment.general: The unique-row arithmetic, original explicit horizon, bridge age, bounded journal and synthetic lineage tests are substantial, but public derived-record forgery, validity intersections, destination-ID collision and duplicate-reference parity need repair coverage.
